note: The full feature list. scripts/build-features.mjs renders it to website/content/features.md; keep it in step with CHANGELOG.md.

features.name: Canvas
features.summary: A whiteboard in a browser tab that you edit by hand while agents edit it beside you, synced live across tabs.

features.name: Two engines
features.summary: Each canvas runs on tldraw or Excalidraw, and converts between them with keys, text, frames and arrows intact.

features.name: Canvas index
features.summary: Every canvas on the server in one page, with thumbnails, to open or start one.

features.name: Templates
features.summary: 33 diagrams (blocks) in six groups, from flowchart and swimlane to SWOT, retro and story map, to start a canvas from or add beside what's there.
features.cli: templates [show ID] · new NAME --template ID · add ID

features.name: Starters and Add
features.summary: Six starters build a canvas on one subject out of several blocks under headings (system design, incident review, product strategy, project kickoff, research plan, team retro); Add puts any block or starter beside what's on a canvas.

features.name: Welcome canvas
features.summary: A first canvas on setup that shows what to try.

features.name: Appearance and your name
features.summary: System, light or dark per browser, and the name shown on your comments.

features.name: Example maps
features.summary: The Odyssey as a story map and Meditations as a map of ideas, with every quotation checked against its source.

features.name: Chat panel
features.summary: Ask in plain words and the agent draws, edits and checks its work on the canvas, using Codex on your own ChatGPT sign-in.

features.name: Fast and Thorough
features.summary: Pick a quick default model or a slower, more careful one for the chat, per browser.

features.name: Steer a turn in progress
features.summary: Send a message while the agent works and it adjusts the turn instead of waiting for it to end.

features.name: Slash commands and Mermaid shortcut
features.summary: Type / to run a routine instantly, or paste a Mermaid flowchart and it lands without a model call.

features.name: New chat
features.summary: Start a fresh conversation with the agent on the same canvas.

features.name: Dock or float the chat
features.summary: Dock the chat left, right or along the bottom, or float it over the canvas, and resize it.

features.name: Sandbox approvals
features.summary: When the agent wants to go outside its sandbox, it asks you in the chat to accept or decline.

features.name: Named agents (profiles)
features.summary: Work with a specific agent on a canvas: its briefing, context and skills load, and people see its name.
features.cli: meta --profile SOURCE/ID · profiles add ID --workdir DIR

features.name: Sticky notes for the agent
features.summary: Pin a note where the problem is; the agent acts on each and turns it green with a one-line reply. Notes are never deleted.

features.name: Comment threads
features.summary: Comment on a shape, several shapes or a region and go back and forth until someone closes it. Each thread has its own agent, so several are worked at once.
features.cli: threads new TEXT --on KEY --ask · threads reply N TEXT

features.name: Notes into threads
features.summary: Bring sticky notes into threads, keeping their replies and resolutions.

features.name: Proposals
features.summary: An agent's suggestion arrives dashed, with Accept and Reject above the canvas. Nothing is final until you say so.
features.app: Proposal bar: Accept all / Reject all

features.name: Agent at work
features.summary: While an agent works, every tab shows a status pill with what it's doing, a soft ring round the canvas, and its cursor on the shape it touched.

features.name: "This": selection awareness
features.summary: Agents can see what you've selected, so "make this bigger" means this.

features.name: Edits glow
features.summary: Shapes an agent adds or changes glow briefly, tagged with its name, in every open tab.

features.name: Details cards
features.summary: Boxes stay short; select one and a card opens with what's behind it, its open threads, and jumps to related boxes.

features.name: Formats: story, ideas, system
features.summary: Give a canvas a format and ← and → walk it from the card, along arrows or a frame.

features.name: Zoomed-out system view
features.summary: Zoom out on a system diagram to see its frames, how many parts each holds, and the connections between them.

features.name: References panel
features.summary: Read files, the project's docs and web pages beside the canvas without leaving it; agents can show you what they wrote.

features.name: Routines
features.summary: Chores banked once and run from a menu, the chat (/name) or the CLI, each one undoable in a single step; grouped by kind (tidy, arrows, layout, style, content, check), each saying when to use it.
features.cli: routine list [--kind K] · routine run NAME

features.name: Clean up and the tidying set
features.summary: Clean up, Lay it out again, Line things up, Even out the gaps, Match box sizes, Fix overlaps, Fit frames, Neat arrows, Colour by frame, Tidy arrows. All run on Excalidraw too.

features.name: Routines from real work
features.summary: Arrows to links, Fit text, Clear arrow labels, Frame these, Stack frames and Open out details: chores agents kept doing by hand.

features.name: Air out
features.summary: Moves long text from crowded boxes into their details, enlarges names and spreads things a little.

features.name: Check this diagram
features.summary: Scores what's drawn out of 100 and names the shapes at fault (overlaps, arrows through boxes, labels on boxes or crossed by other arrows), so an agent can fix what it finds.

features.name: Bank your own routine
features.summary: Ask the chat to make a chore a routine, paste code, or save one from the CLI; it appears in the menu for every canvas.

features.name: Routines learned from work
features.summary: A work log of what agents do on canvases; toucan suggests the code they keep writing by hand as routines to bank, and shows which routines get used.
features.cli: routine suggest · routine stats · routine learn --codex

features.name: Canvas scripts
features.summary: Persistent behaviour stored with a canvas, such as a button that re-routes arrows.

features.name: Timeline-aware tidying
features.summary: On a timeline, tidying keeps dates where they are: positions and widths are dates.

features.name: History and restore
features.summary: Every canvas keeps versions, whoever made the change. Step through them read-only over the live canvas and restore one; a restore can be undone.
features.cli: versions · versions save LABEL · versions restore N

features.name: One undo per agent action
features.summary: An agent's run, a routine or an accepted proposal is a single undo step.

features.name: Upgrade-aware tabs
features.summary: A tab left open across an upgrade says so and reloads in one click; `toucan reload --all` brings every open tab up to date at once.

features.name: While you were away
features.summary: Edits agents made with no tab open are logged and announced when you come back.

features.name: A folder per canvas
features.summary: What agents write for a canvas goes in its own folder, archived with it, and nowhere else in the data directory.

features.name: The toucan CLI
features.summary: Read a canvas, run JavaScript in the live editor, screenshot it, and merge diagrams in by key, from any terminal agent.

features.name: Describe it as data
features.summary: An agent describes a diagram and a layout engine places it, which is why drawing takes seconds.

features.name: Connect your agents
features.summary: Teaches Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, pi, Cursor, opencode and Claude Desktop to use toucan, by skill or MCP.

features.name: MCP server
features.summary: For agents that can't run the CLI, including Codex in its default sandbox.

features.name: A canvas per project
features.summary: toucan init finds or makes the canvas for the repository you're in; commands there use it without --canvas.

features.name: Headless mode
features.summary: With no tab open, agents still read and edit: the server runs the canvas in its own headless page.

features.name: Node client and extensions
features.summary: A Node client for scripts, and toucan X runs toucan-X so extensions live in their own repos.

features.name: Animated build
features.summary: A GIF of the diagram building up box by box, in the order the arrows go, to drop into a doc, a slide or a chat.

features.name: Mermaid in and out
features.summary: Paste or import Mermaid: on a blank canvas it looks like a template, and on a full one it merges by key.

features.name: JSON Canvas, Excalidraw, DOT
features.summary: Import and export JSON Canvas (Obsidian) and .excalidraw; export DOT.

features.name: Toucan graph
features.summary: An engine-neutral graph format, with keyed upsert import and automatic layout.

features.name: One-line install
features.summary: Installs a prebuilt release, starts the server, connects your agents and opens a first canvas.

features.name: Setup and doctor
features.summary: setup asks nothing, so an agent can run it; doctor says what's wrong and what to do.

features.name: A server that looks after itself
features.summary: Commands start a background server when needed, and never fight one you run yourself.

features.name: Remote and behind a proxy
features.summary: Run on another machine or behind a reverse proxy, with the address people browse and the names it answers to.
